subject: [PATCH v5 5/7] sched/numa: scan PID-inactive VMAs for promotion

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Addressed concerns about the impact of the changes on Sashiko's behavior and acknowledged that it may be worth a separate commit to fix the issue, but deemed it low-impact.

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch series enhances the vma scanning logic in the Linux kernel's scheduler to promote hot slow-tier memory by bypassing a filter that suppresses faults for inactive VMAs. The changes allow for more efficient memory tiering and reduce CXL bandwidth utilization, resulting in major throughput improvements for database workloads.
